text.marquee: RANK UP CITY · BUILDING 4 · THE CORPORATE VAULT
text.tagline:
Rewrite the sentence. Collect the digits.
Beat the clock.
text.taglineEs: Reescribe, informa y negocia contra el reloj. Cada acierto te da un dígito <ico-key></ico-key>.
text.help: Each chamber has one clock. Read the door, then rewrite the sentence, report the message or choose the line. A wrong answer costs fifteen seconds, not a heart. Every right answer gives you a digit, and the code opens the keypad at the end. Stuck? Enri's purr boost gives you a hint.
text.bossWin: The final door is open, and it's only eight fifty-nine. You're out, the pitch is ready, and you rank up to C1. The official B2 exam is waiting for you.
text.gameOver: The clock beat you this time. The vault resets every hour. Take a breath and try again.
text.good: Out with time to spare. VAULT OS almost sounded impressed. Your prize is waiting. Claim it!
text.ok: That chamber was tight. Run it back for a better card, or claim your prize anyway.

boss.name: THE FINAL DOOR
boss.quote: Open. And it's only eight fifty-nine.

epic.name: VAULT OS
epic.quote: Rewrite the sentence. Then the door opens.

common.name: ACCESS BADGE
common.quote: Access granted. For now. Run it back!

s1.name: Identity check
s1.intro: Bad news, rookie. It's the night before the big pitch, the tower's security system has locked down, and you're on the vault floor. Four chambers and a final door before nine a.m. Every right answer gives you a digit. A wrong answer costs time, not a heart. First, VAULT OS wants to know who you are.

rounds.line: Identity check. How long have you been working in this building?
options: I've been working here for two years.
I work here since two years.
I'm working here for two years.
rounds.retryLine: Answer not recognized. From then until now, and still going.

rounds.line: How many projects have you led?
options: I've led three.
I've been leading three.
I led three until now.
rounds.retryLine: Answer not recognized. Count the finished projects.

rounds.line: Describe the power use on this floor tonight.
rounds.title: POWER USE
options: It rose sharply at midnight.
It fell steadily all night.
It leveled off at ten and then dropped.
rounds.retryLine: Incorrect. Look at midnight.
rounds.thanks: Correct. Somebody switched the vault on at midnight.

rounds.line: Explain the situation to the security desk. Begin as a presenter would.
rounds.answer: Let me walk you through the problem
rounds.retryLine: Not recognized. Let me, then walk you through.

rounds.line: Final check. Describe the temperature in the vault.
rounds.title: VAULT TEMPERATURE
options: There was a slight drop at two a.m.
It fell dramatically at two a.m.
It rose steadily after one a.m.
rounds.retryLine: Inaccurate. Three degrees is not dramatic.

s2.name: The archive
s2.intro: The archive. These doors only accept the passive voice: the door was locked, the files have been moved. Rewrite fast. The clock is running.

rounds.line: Door one. Passive voice required.
rounds.source: Someone locked the door at nine.
rounds.answer: The door was locked at nine
alts: The door was locked at nine by someone
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. The door is the subject.

rounds.line: Complete the security notice. The code ___ by the system every hour.
options: is changed
changes
is changing
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. By the system: the code does not change itself.

rounds.line: Door two. Passive voice required.
alts: The files have been moved by them
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Have been, plus the past participle.
rounds.thanks: Accepted. The files are where they are.

rounds.line: Status report. The system ___ right now. Please wait.
options: is being updated
is updated
has been updating
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Right now, and something is doing it to the system.
rounds.thanks: Update in progress. Thank you for waiting.

rounds.line: Door three. Passive voice, and name the agent.
rounds.source: A guard will open the door.
rounds.answer: The door will be opened by a guard
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Will be, plus the past participle.
rounds.thanks: Accepted. A guard is on his way. Eventually.

s3.name: The message room
s3.intro: The message room. David left voicemails before the lockdown. Report them accurately: he said he would, he asked if. One of them hides a digit, so listen to the details.

rounds.line: One new message from David. Report it accurately.
rounds.clipText: It's David. I'll send the code tomorrow.
options: He said he would send the code the next day.
He said he will send the code yesterday.
He said he had sent the code the day before.
rounds.retryLine: Inaccurate report. Play it again.

rounds.line: Message two. A question.
rounds.clipText: David again. Did you get my email?
options: He asked if I had gotten his email.
He asked did I get his email.
He asked if I have got my email.
rounds.retryLine: Inaccurate. A reported question: if, then statement order.
rounds.thanks: Report filed. You did not reply. Noted.

rounds.line: Door four. David's warning, reported.
rounds.source: "Don't touch the red button," David said to me.
rounds.answer: He warned me not to touch the red button
alts: He told me not to touch the red button
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Warned me, then not to.
rounds.thanks: Accepted. Please do not touch the red button.

rounds.line: Message three. This one has a detail you will need.
rounds.clipText: It's David. Forget what I said this morning. The new code ends in eight, not five.
options: He said that the new code ended in eight, not five.
He said that the new code ends in five.
He asked if the code ended in eight.
rounds.retryLine: Inaccurate. Which number did he correct?
rounds.thanks: Report filed. The digit is eight.

rounds.line: Door five. A reported question.
rounds.answer: He asked where the key was
alts: He asked me where the key was
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Statement word order, please.

s4.name: The night guard
s4.intro: The night guard. Walt can open the next door, but only if you negotiate. Conditions, polite offers, and one formal message to the director. Be nice to Walt. He has the keys.

rounds.line: I can't open it, mate. Rules are rules.
options: If you were to open it, I would sign the log myself.
Open it now or I call your boss.
If you would open it, I will sign.
rounds.retryLine: Nah. Try me again, politely, and get the grammar right.
rounds.thanks: Well… if you sign the log. Go on, then.

rounds.line: I could ring the director, but she won't like being woken up. What's your offer?
rounds.answer: I will wait provided that you call the director
alts: Provided that you call the director I will wait
rounds.retryLine: Make it a condition, mate. Provided that…
rounds.thanks: Fair enough. I'll ring her. You wait right there.

rounds.line: Message to the director's inbox. Choose the formal version.
options: I would be grateful if you could authorize the exit.
Can you let me out, please? Thanks!
Let me out now.
rounds.retryLine: Register not accepted. This is the director.

rounds.line: Door six. The director prefers formal English. Rewrite.
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Apologize for, and a formal noun.

rounds.line: Hang on. If you'd told me earlier, I'd have opened it hours ago.
options: If I had known, I would have called you.
If I knew, I would call you.
If I would have known, I had called you.
rounds.retryLine: Too late for that now, mate. Had known, would have.
rounds.thanks: No harm done. Door's open. Mind the step.

sb.name: The final door
sb.intro: This is it: the final door. One long countdown and five locks, one for each skill you've used tonight. The last one is the first line of tomorrow's pitch. Open it, and you rank up to C1. Go!

chamber.keypadTitle: THE FINAL DOOR · ENTER THE CODE

rounds.line: Lock one. Experience. From then until now.
rounds.source: I started work on this pitch in March, and I'm still working on it.
rounds.answer: I have been working on this pitch since March
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Have been working, and since.

rounds.line: Lock two. Passive voice.
rounds.source: The board will review the pitch at nine.
rounds.answer: The pitch will be reviewed by the board at nine
alts: The pitch will be reviewed at nine by the board
The pitch will be reviewed at nine
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. The pitch is the subject now.

rounds.line: Lock three. Reported speech.
rounds.source: "The vault will open at eight," Walt said.
rounds.answer: Walt said the vault would open at eight
alts: Walt said that the vault would open at eight
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. One step back in time: will becomes would.

rounds.line: Lock four. A hypothetical condition.
rounds.source: We don't have the code, so we can't open the door.
rounds.answer: If we had the code we could open the door
alts: We could open the door if we had the code
If we had the code we would open the door
We would open the door if we had the code
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Imaginary now: if plus the past, then could.

rounds.line: Lock five. The board reads your first line at nine. Formal, please.
rounds.answer: Thank you all for your time this morning
rounds.retryLine: Register not accepted. No guys in a boardroom.
rounds.thanks: Lock five: open. Enter the code.
